authority: User2026-10-28: performance budget should be a range, not a hard limit; SysON parity is the priority
supersedes: Single50ms timing veto in active plan briefs and historical execution limit strings; original receipts/findings/measurements remain immutable historical observations
range_meaning: Initial engineering target bands for event-to-settled-visible-result latency on the pinned owned host, not lower-bound requirements, universal maxima, native-derived promises or automatic pass/fail cutoffs. Faster is acceptable. Match fixture/action/metric before comparisons.

workloads.scope: Typing/caret/scroll/drag feedback already local to native controls; record input event to next visible feedback
Select/stage/cancel/commit on fixed small fixture <=50modelnodes and<=64KiB serialized model; exclude setup/networkidle
Named512child or32node/64edge fixture; record each action and model bytes separately
Named accepted700258byte import/900381byte export or850k scalar; record exact input/model/output sizes, expansion and operation; do not extrapolate to native documented capacity

measurement.required: Pinned source/artifact/fixture/host/browser/viewport; raw event-to-settled latency and distinct main-thread longtask durations. Do not compare helper phase, Layout, RunTask and end-to-end as the same metric.
measurement.samples: For new performance qualification:2warmups+7measured repetitions per named action/viewport; report all raw samples,min,median,max. Label smaller counts observations only. Claim p95 only with>=30measured samples and disclose estimator. Exclude waits/setup explicitly. Repeat only for changed code or specifically admitted measurement work.
measurement.longtask: Record every >=50ms task and cumulative blocked time as diagnostics;50ms is no longer a universal release/feature veto. Keep operation/phase/input context.
measurement.memory: Keep allocation requests, peak live heap and RSS separate; counts alone do not establish high-water bounds. Memory/request/admission quotas remain hard integrity constraints.
measurement.native: Compare exact equivalent SysON/Rust user operations and same fixture/metric on pinned artifacts; archive/version deltas remain explicit. No unmatched ratios.
measurement.regression: Report old/new distribution and outliers on equivalent qualified inputs; no broad speedup from one sample.
measurement.state_control: Restore identical fixture, selection, pending drafts and history preconditions before every measured action; record restoration outside timing window. Disclose paired old/new order; alternate order when measuring regression to avoid warm-cache/order confounds.

acceptance: Prioritize correct usable SysON workflows. Review the workload distribution, responsiveness, cancellation and outliers; explain material excursions and assign scoped follow-up. A timing excursion alone does not veto a parity PR, and falling inside a band alone does not prove performance/usability acceptance. Data loss, corrupt state, unbounded admission and unusable controls remain correctness blockers.
unresolved: Calibration against matched native workloads, wider browsers/devices, full renderer memory/capacity and distribution measurements remain open; earlier290/287ms task observations are neither relabelled as a pass nor a current hard-budget failure.
